source: Indiana State Department of Health, Mortality Report, Table 9: Deaths from Selected Injury and Poisoning Causes by Age Group, Indiana Residents by County (all-ages Total)
note: Indiana ISDH Mortality Report Table 9 (injury and poisoning causes), all-ages Total per county. THIS FILE: 2003-2017 (2000-2002 editions are in in_injury_county_2000-2002.json; merge them per cause before the build so the 50-county-year agreement check sees all years). Stated rules: 2003-2009 and 2014-2017 editions publish every county with no suppression stated. The 2010 edition footnote reads 'Numbers less than 5, including 0, for at least one age grouping, have been suppressed to protect confidentiality' and replaces the whole cause row with '**' for 46 of 92 counties; those cells are left out here, not treated as zero, and are NOT unhidden. The 2011, 2012 and 2013 editions publish Table 9 only for the 17 counties over 100,000 population (publisher's scope, not suppression). firearm (all intents, CDC-style) = firearm_accidental + firearm_suicide + firearm_homicide + firearm_undetermined (legal-intervention firearm deaths are not split out, so it can run slightly below CDC). poisoning_accidental (X40-X49) is NOT CDC's overdose definition. accidents_all, transport, legal_intervention have no MortalGIS measure yet.
log: 46 of 92 counties have every row masked with ** (stated: numbers <5 incl. 0 for at least one age grouping suppressed)
